meta.title: A negative quantity is accepted (no sign check)
gaps: No operation is available to change the existing draft line quantity to -5.
The case does not name a METHOD and path for a custom request, so request cannot express the line update.
No operation or read-back is available to read the originating PR line after publication.
The available negative-quantity library cases create or modify different states and cannot express this exact draft-to-publish journey.
